title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

£40,000 - £45,000 Basic + Uncapped Commission: Shrewsbury: Hybrid Flexibility

What if your next sales territory was America, but your commute was only to Shrewsbury?

And what if there was no ceiling on your commission?

Because if you're good at sales, know your way around pneumatics and compressed air systems, and love turning a conversation into an order, imagine what you could do with an entire country to go at.
As Business Development Executive, that's exactly what you'll have.

Starting on the East Coast and gradually working your way west, you'll be introducing a clever piece of British engineering to the American industrial market and because you understand pneumatics, you'll know just how much of a problem moisture, oil and contamination can be in compressed air systems.

You'll also understand why a filtration solution that reduces maintenance and ongoing costs is worth talking about.
- Manufacturing.
- Food production.
- Automotive.
- Aggregates.
- Oil and gas.

Think about how many businesses across America rely on compressed air every single day.

Now, imagine being the person introducing them to something that could make a genuine difference.

You're not somebody who waits for the phone to ring, are you?
You're the Business Development Executive who enjoys the chase. Who doesn't get put off when the first person says no. Who knows that sometimes the best customers are the ones you had to work that little bit harder to win.
You're confident picking up the phone, building relationships over Teams and recognising when a conversation has the potential to become something much bigger.

Because you've worked around pneumatics, compressed air equipment or industrial filtration, you can have a proper technical conversation without needing an engineer beside you for every call.

Now, let's talk about those American hours

Rather than trying to squeeze your life around a traditional nine-to-five, you'll be working later to coincide with your customers across the Atlantic.
Which means your mornings could look rather different.
The school run, gym session. An appointment you normally have to take annual leave for. Or simply getting things done while everyone else is at work.
Then, when America starts its working day, so do you.

You'll be based in Shrewsbury, with hybrid flexibility once you're established and delivering results.

And you won't be micromanaged. As Business Development Executive, you'll be trusted to build your territory, develop relationships and bring in the business.

And here's the part I think you'll really like.

£40,000 - £45,000 basic salary with an uncapped commission.

Not a bonus that stops just as you're getting going the better you perform, the more you have the potential to earn.

You're building a market from the ground up, with an established product and a knowledgeable technical team behind you, what they need is someone who can sell it.

Perhaps you're currently selling pneumatic equipment, air compressors, filtration systems or other compressed air solutions. You know the industry, you're good at what you do, but you're starting to wonder what else is out there.
You don't necessarily need experience selling into America, but experience or a strong working knowledge of pneumatics and compressed air systems is essential, alongside a genuine track record of winning new business.

Because this Business Development Executive role isn't about maintaining an existing customer list.
It's about creating one!

And if you're the sort of Business Development Executive who gets excited by the thought of building a territory, winning customers and seeing those wins reflected in your earnings, I think we should have a conversation.
America is a pretty big place just think what you could make of it.

title: International Sales Executive - USA & Canada
company: Thomas Lee Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Salary: £40,000 basic + uncapped commission

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Pattern: Initially office-based, with opportunities for greater flexibility as trust and performance develop. Working hours must accommodate customers in North America.

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an established engineering products business looking to strengthen its international sales team, with a particular focus on developing business across the USA and Canada.

This is an opportunity for a commercially driven salesperson who understands the North American business environment and enjoys developing new relationships, identifying opportunities and converting enquiries into sales.

Ideally, you will already have experience selling products or services into the US or Canadian markets and understand the communication, relationship-building and commercial approaches involved.

The business supplies specialist engineering products, including compressed-air and filtration-related solutions. Previous experience with these products would be advantageous, but it is not essential.

We are more interested in someone who knows how to sell successfully into North America, has the right attitude and is confident learning a new product range.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop new B2 B sales opportunities across the USA and Canada.
- Identify and approach prospective customers, distributors and commercial partners.
- Build strong relationships with North American customers and develop existing accounts.
- Research potential customers, understand their requirements and identify suitable solutions.
- Manage sales enquiries, prepare quotations and follow up opportunities through to orders.
- Work proactively to build a sustainable pipeline of international business.
- Develop a strong understanding of the company's specialist engineering products and their applications.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information and sales activity.
- Work closely with the wider sales team to achieve commercial objectives.
- Communicate effectively with customers across North American time zones.

About You

We are particularly interested in candidates who have previous experience selling into the USA or Canada - but not necessarily vital. You might currently be working in international sales, export sales, business development, account management or a commercially focused B2 B sales position.

Experience within engineering, manufacturing, industrial equipment or technical distribution would be beneficial. However, we would also welcome applications from successful salespeople in other B2 B sectors who can demonstrate transferable experience.

What We're Looking For
- Previous B2 B sales experience, ideally involving customers in the USA or Canada.
- A proven ability to identify opportunities, develop relationships and generate new business.
- An understanding of the practical challenges of selling across international markets.
- Confidence communicating with North American customers, including by telephone and video call.
- Strong commercial awareness, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach to developing sales opportunities.
- The ability and willingness to learn specialist technical products.
- Good organisational skills and confidence using CRM systems.
- Flexibility to work hours that align with the North American business day.
- Ambition, resilience and a genuine desire to succeed.

Previous experience selling compressed-air systems, filtration products or engineering equipment would be an advantage, but is not required.

What the Role Offers
- £40,000 basic salary.
- Uncapped commission with substantial earning potential.
- The opportunity to develop business across the USA and Canada.
- An established specialist product range with opportunities to develop technical knowledge.
- The chance to build long-term international customer relationships.
- A commercially focused environment where initiative and results are valued.
- Potential for greater working flexibility as you become established in the role.

Working Arrangements

This role involves regular communication with customers across the USA and Canada.

Candidates must be comfortable working hours that accommodate North American time zones.

The position will initially be office-based in Shrewsbury, with the opportunity for increased flexibility as working relationships, trust and performance develop.

The Right Person

Ultimately, the business is looking for someone with commercial drive, a positive attitude and the determination to build successful customer relationships.

If you have experience selling into North American markets and would welcome the opportunity to develop a specialist engineering product range, we would be interested in hearing from you.

About Us

At Thomas Lee Recruitment, we specialise in connecting engineers and technical salespeople with leading companies in the engineering sector. We pride ourselves on offering a personalised, professional, and transparent recruitment service. Our focus is on understanding both client and candidate needs to ensure the best possible match.

How to Apply

All applications will be responded to. Please ensure you have the right to work in the UK before applying.

By applying for this role, you accept our Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, and Disclaimers, which can be found on our website.

title: Part-Time Telesales / Appointment Setter
description:
Part-Time Telesales / Appointment Setter

Pay: £15.00 per hour + holiday pay
Hours: 10:00am 4:00pm, 3 to 5 days per week
Job Type: Part-Time, Permanent

An established Shrewsbury company that manufactures a large range of commercial vacuum cleaners and professional cleaning equipment is looking for an experienced Telesales / Appointment Setter to join their office on a part-time basis.

- Professional telephone manner.

Hours & Pay
- £15.00 per hour + holiday pay
- 10:00am 4:00pm, 3 to 5 days per week
- Permanent, part-time position.
- Office based in Shrewsbury no home working.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced salesperson looking for regular part-time hours.

Apply today for more information.

title: Telesales
description:
Business Development Executive

Shrewsbury Office-based 25,000- 35,000 basic + commission + annual bonus OTE up to 50,000

The opportunity

Our client is a growing UK technology business developing innovative AI and customer engagement solutions for organisations across a range of sectors.

The company is entering an exciting period of commercial growth and is now looking for a Business Development Executive to join its expanding sales operation.

This is a genuinely proactive new-business role. You will be responsible for identifying and engaging prospective customers, creating new sales opportunities and booking qualified meetings for the wider commercial team.

You'll work closely with senior commercial leadership in a small, ambitious team, giving you the opportunity to make a visible contribution rather than simply becoming another number in a large sales organisation.

The role

This is a phone-led outbound business development position suited to someone who enjoys opening doors, speaking to decision-makers and turning prospects into genuine commercial opportunities.

You won't be handed an entirely cold list and left to figure it out yourself. The business has already invested in building a researched database of target organisations, prioritised accounts and identified decision-makers.

Your job will be to turn that research into conversations.

You will use a combination of telephone, email and LinkedIn to introduce the business, understand potential customer requirements, qualify opportunities and secure meetings for the sales team.

There is a strong emphasis on activity, ownership and results, so this role will suit someone who enjoys having clear targets and taking responsibility for their own pipeline.

What you'll be doing
- Proactively contacting prospective customers by telephone, email and LinkedIn
- Researching target organisations and identifying relevant decision-makers
- Making confident, professional cold calls to senior stakeholders
- Introducing the company's technology and value proposition clearly and credibly
- Asking the right questions to understand business needs and qualify opportunities
- Booking high-quality meetings for the wider sales team
- Following up marketing campaigns, events and inbound enquiries
- Maintaining accurate prospect and activity information within the CRM
- Managing your own pipeline, diary and follow-up activity
- Working towards agreed activity, opportunity and revenue targets
- Working closely with senior commercial colleagues to develop new markets and opportunities

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is confident, commercially minded and comfortable picking up the phone.

You don't necessarily need years of experience. What's more important is that you're motivated by winning new business, resilient when things don't go your way and disciplined enough to consistently follow up.

Essential
- Confidence speaking to senior decision-makers on the telephone
- Comfortable making outbound and cold calls
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
- Ability to work independently and manage your own workload
- Good organisation and attention to detail
- A disciplined approach to follow-up and CRM management
- Resilience and persistence - you understand that not every conversation becomes an opportunity
- A genuine interest in technology and new business
- Right to work in the UK

Desirable
- Previous experience in business development, lead generation, inside sales or a similar role
- Experience in SaaS, software, AI, technology or another consultative sales environment
- Experience selling into sectors such as retail, education, hospitality, automotive or the charity sector
- Experience engaging with senior decision-makers or C-suite contacts

What's on offer?
- 25,000- 35,000 basic salary, depending on experience
- OTE up to 50,000
- Uncapped commission on the business you generate
- Annual performance bonus linked to achievement of agreed targets
- Commission payable on orders you originate, including opportunities subsequently progressed and closed by other members of the sales team
- Additional company benefits
- Clear opportunity for progression as the commercial team grows

Career progression

This isn't intended to be a role where you simply spend your career booking meetings.

For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to progress into a broader full-cycle sales role, taking responsibility for your own appointments, attending client meetings, developing relationships and ultimately closing business yourself.

As your responsibility grows, so does your earning potential.

If you're already operating at that level, we'd also be interested in speaking with you.

Working hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm

This is a predominantly office-based position in Shrewsbury, with occasional overnight travel for industry events, meetings and customer visits.

Interested?

If you're an ambitious Business Development Executive, Sales Development Representative or experienced appointment setter who enjoys opening new conversations and wants the opportunity to develop within a growing technology business, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential conversation about the role.

title: Account Manager
description:
Partnerships Associate
Remote working (UK based)
£28,000 + Comms - 1st year OTE £38,000
Start date Monday 7th December 2026

Experience within Real Estate Sales or Conveyancing is ESSENTIAL for consideration in this role

Join a collaborative and ambitious team supporting the growth of referral partnerships within a modern, fast-growing conveyancing business.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for a motivated, relationship-driven Partnerships Associate to play a key part in building and nurturing relationships with estate agents and mortgage brokers, helping to drive new business and support continued growth.

The business operates nationally and specialises in residential conveyancing, using technology and streamlined processes to improve the experience for clients and referral partners alike. Ongoing growth has created the need for someone who enjoys speaking to people, building long-term partnerships and working towards clear performance targets in a supportive, high-performing environment.

About the role
- Build and manage relationships with referral partners, including estate agents and mortgage brokers
- Make outbound calls to warm contacts who have previously worked with the business
- Gather feedback and introduce partners to the referral process
- Convert suitable contacts into active referrers and build a strong referral pipeline
- Clearly explain services offered, including scope of work and expectations
- Assess prospective partners for long-term suitability and alignment
- Act as the main relationship manager, maintaining regular contact and handling queries or escalations
- Monitor referral performance, lead flow and conversion rates
- Work towards weekly and monthly targets

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys relationship building, is confident on the phone and thrives in a target-driven environment.

About you
- Relationship-focused with strong communication skills
- Confident speaking with external partners
- Comfortable managing multiple relationships and priorities
- Target-driven and motivated by results
- Organised, professional and responsive
- Experience working with estate agents, mortgage brokers or referral-led partnerships to the industry is essential

Salary
- Basic salary of £28,000
- On-target earnings of £38,000 in the first year
- Commission expected to grow significantly as relationships mature after year one

The opportunity This is a strong opportunity to develop a career within a growing business that values long-term relationships, collaboration and performance.
